title: VoteEvent
description: A single vote taken by a body, with its tally and optionally each member's cast vote. Modelled on Popolo VoteEvent/Count/Vote rather than schema:VoteAction, because VoteAction is built around choosing a candidate and has no way to express aye, nay, or abstain on a motion. Publishing the counts alone is valid; publishing individual votes is what makes a record auditable.

name.description: What was voted on, e.g. 'Motion to adopt Ordinance 2025-15'.

requiredMajority.description: The threshold that applied, e.g. 'simple', 'twoThirds', 'absolute'. Without it a reader cannot tell whether a 4-3 vote carried.

count.description: The tally. Popolo Count: one entry per option.

role.description: The Post or role the voter held at the time, where relevant.
